sentences.text: Melanargia galathea is mainly observed in Mainz-Bingen from June to July, with the highest number of reports in June.
It is recorded as a pollinator of the Carthusian Pink, Small Scabious and field scabious.
Further pollination is recorded for zigzag clover, Red Clover, Betony and Oxeye Daisy.
In addition, 23 GloBI records document flower visits to field scabious.
